title: Find N Unique Integers Sum up to Zero
statement: Return n distinct integers whose sum is zero.

title: Find N Unique Integers Sum up to Zero
statement: Return n distinct integers whose sum is zero.
code: class Solution { public int[] sumZero(int n){int[]a=new int[n];int i=0;for(int x=1;x<=n/2;x++){a[i++]=x;a[i++]=-x;}if(n%2==1)a[i]=0;return a;} }

approach_name: Repeat each value by its frequency

title: Decompress Run-Length Encoded List
statement: Decode [freq, val] pairs into a list containing freq copies of val.
approach_name: Repeat each value by its frequency
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] decompressRLElist(int[] nums){List<Integer>out=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i+=2)for(int j=0;j<nums[i];j++)out.add(nums[i+1]);int[]a=new int[out.size()];for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)a[i]=out.get(i);return a;} }

title: Maximum 69 Number
statement: Return the largest number possible by changing at most one digit from 6 to 9.
code: class Solution { public int maximum69Number(int num){char[]a=String.valueOf(num).toCharArray();for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i]=='6'){a[i]='9';break;}return Integer.parseInt(new String(a));} }

title: Rank Transform of an Array
statement: Replace each array value with its rank, where the smallest distinct value has rank 1 and equal values share a rank.
approach_name: Map sorted distinct values to ranks
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] arrayRankTransform(int[] arr){int[]s=arr.clone();Arrays.sort(s);Map<Integer,Integer>rank=new HashMap<>();for(int x:s)if(!rank.containsKey(x))rank.put(x,rank.size()+1);int[]out=new int[arr.length];for(int i=0;i<arr.length;i++)out[i]=rank.get(arr[i]);return out;} }

title: Number of Steps to Reduce a Number to Zero
statement: Count steps to reduce a nonnegative integer to zero by dividing evens by two and subtracting one from odds.
code: class Solution { public int numberOfSteps(int num){int ans=0;while(num>0){num=num%2==0?num/2:num-1;ans++;}return ans;} }

title: Count Negative Numbers in a Sorted Matrix
statement: Count negative numbers in a matrix whose rows and columns are sorted in nonincreasing order.
code: class Solution { public int countNegatives(int[][] grid){int ans=0;for(int[]row:grid)for(int x:row)if(x<0)ans++;return ans;} }

title: How Many Numbers Are Smaller Than the Current Number
statement: For each value, return how many array values are strictly smaller than it.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] smallerNumbersThanCurrent(int[] nums){int[]s=nums.clone();Arrays.sort(s);Map<Integer,Integer>rank=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<s.length;i++)rank.putIfAbsent(s[i],i);int[]out=new int[nums.length];for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)out[i]=rank.get(nums[i]);return out;} }

title: Increasing Decreasing String
statement: Reorder characters by repeatedly taking the smallest available character, then the largest, until none remain.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String sortString(String s){int[]c=new int[26];for(char x:s.toCharArray())c[x-'a']++;StringBuilder b=new StringBuilder();while(b.length()<s.length()){for(int i=0;i<26;i++)if(c[i]>0){b.append((char)('a'+i));c[i]--;}for(int i=25;i>=0;i--)if(c[i]>0){b.append((char)('a'+i));c[i]--;}}return b.toString();} }

title: Lucky Numbers in a Matrix
statement: Return all elements that are the minimum in their row and maximum in their column.
approach_name: Intersect row minima with column maxima
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<Integer> luckyNumbers (int[][] matrix){int m=matrix.length,n=matrix[0].length;List<Integer>out=new ArrayList<>();for(int r=0;r<m;r++){int min=matrix[r][0],cidx=0;for(int c=1;c<n;c++)if(matrix[r][c]<min){min=matrix[r][c];cidx=c;}boolean max=true;for(int i=0;i<m;i++)if(matrix[i][cidx]>min)max=false;if(max)out.add(min);}return out;} }

title: Create Target Array in the Given Order
statement: Build a target array by inserting nums[i] at index index[i] in iteration order.

title: Create Target Array in the Given Order
statement: Build a target array by inserting nums[i] at index index[i] in iteration order.
code: class Solution { public int[] createTargetArray(int[] nums,int[] index){int[]out=new int[nums.length];int size=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){for(int j=size;j>index[i];j--)out[j]=out[j-1];out[index[i]]=nums[i];size++;}return out;} }
